name: IJ – configurable decision tree

validation.description: 2,000 practice transactions picked at random from training (not the most recent month, so not directly comparable with the other models' holdouts)

notes: Decision tree (max depth 6) on transaction signals plus a late-night flag. Settings live in fraud_detection/config.json on ijBranch: prediction method (decision tree or weighted rules), tree depth, 20% probability cutoff and rule weights.
